gloss: already; no longer; now; by this point

definitions.explanation: Used with negative expressions to indicate that something is no longer the case. Implies a change from a previous state.

definitions.gloss: already; by now; at this point
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a situation has reached a certain point. Often used to emphasize that something has become inevitable or has progressed beyond a certain stage.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{最早|もはや}{子供|こども}ではない。
examples.english: She is no longer a child.

examples.japanese: {最早|もはや}{手遅|ておく}れだ。
これは{最早|もはや}{災害|さいがい}レベルの{暑|あつ}さだ。
examples.english: This heat is already at disaster level.

notes:
TWO MAIN USES:

1) WITH NEGATIVE: No longer
・{最早|もはや}〜ない (no longer ~)
・{最早|もはや}{元|もと}には{戻|もど}らない (will no longer return to the original state)

2) EMPHATIC: By now/already (situation has reached a point)
・{最早|もはや}これまで (this is the end/it's all over now)
・{最早|もはや}{避|さ}けられない (at this point, unavoidable)

WRITING NOTE:
Often written in hiragana as もはや. The kanji {最早|もはや} is more formal/literary.

REGISTER:
{最早|もはや} has a slightly literary or formal tone. In casual speech, もう is more common.
・{最早|もはや}〜ない (literary) = もう〜ない (casual)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{最早|もはや}{疑|うたが}う{余地|よち}はない (there's no longer room for doubt)
・{最早|もはや}{言|い}い{訳|わけ}できない (can no longer make excuses)
